dwg_parse.unit_bay_source: V1 window labels at 3-bay spacing: DWG X spacings [-6119,-7948,-9777] → 1829 DWG units × 3.280 = 5999mm ≈ 6000mm. Confirmed by second group [-14240,-15956,-17897] same spacing.

unit_depth_evidence: LinearDimension '1844.04'×3 ×3.280mm/DWG=6048mm; area texts '3.00 X 6.05=18.15M' and '6.00 X 6.05=36.3M' (depth=6.05m=6050mm ±2mm). QM expands in WIDTH not depth.
outer_envelope_note: room 6048mm + futura-ampliación frame 1502mm (back inner Y=-28637 to futura front Y=-26335, 2302 DWG×3.280); context only, not gated depth

footprint_crosscheck.status: PASS — non-tautological, 3 independent parses (width, depth, area)

roof_note: Horizontal parapet line confirmed in DWG screenshot (qm_dwg_elevation_zone.jpg). No pitch or ridge. Wall top: 7280mm (exact +7.28 DWG marker). Parapet: 7280mm to 7460mm = 180mm. H_TOTAL=7460mm exact (+7.46 DWG marker). NOTE: prior roof_note erroneously stated 7020/440 — those were the wrong 3×2340 derivation values.

floor_levels.slab_1: 2340mm (exact from N.P.T+2.34 DWG marker — GF ceiling = upper unit floor)
floor_levels.slab_2: 4680mm (exact from N.P.T+4.68 DWG marker — upper unit ceiling = expansion floor)
floor_levels.wall_top: 7280mm (exact from +7.28 DWG marker — top of concrete wall = roof slab surface)
floor_levels.parapet_top: 7460mm (exact from +7.46 DWG marker — top of parapet coping)
floor_levels.floor_heights: floor1=2340mm, floor2=2340mm, floor3=2600mm (7280-4680, NOT 2340 — top expansion floor is taller)
floor_levels.reconciliation_note: 3×2340=7020 derivation was WRONG. Exact markers: H_WALL=7280mm, parapet=180mm. Total 7460mm unchanged.
floor_levels.delivered_parapet_note: +3.29m marker (3290mm) = height of delivered 1-story ground unit (2340mm slab + 950mm parapet before upper unit self-build)

fenestration.window_source: V1 labels at DWG Z_real=+1999mm (head level), sill deduced from T8/T9 label at +1300mm (center) → sill = 2×1300-2000 = 600mm. Width from horizontal sill lines at Z+610mm ≈ 200 DWG units × 3.280 = 656mm ≈ 660mm.
fenestration.large_panel_note: P2 label at Z≈+595mm in left-bay group. Ground floor has large opening (half-bay width ~3000mm) — the unbuilt self-build zone. Delivered portion has 1 entry door + 1 V1 window per 3m unit.

bay_structure.stacking: ground unit (0-2340mm) + upper unit (2340-4680mm) per structural bay
bay_structure.self_build: futura ampliación: 4680-7460mm above the stacked lower pair (expansion floors for each unit)
bay_structure.facade_per_bay: Right half: delivered concrete + entry door + V1 window per floor. Left half: open structural frame (self-build zone).

room_areas_from_dwg.main_room: 3.00m × 6.05m = 18.15 M² (ground floor unit — confirmed in DWG annotation)
room_areas_from_dwg.upper_room: 3.75m × 2.96m = 11.10 M² (upper floor unit or partitioned space)
room_areas_from_dwg.total_upper: 16.33 M² (upper unit per bay, half-house delivered)

dim_annotations.grid_module_note: 914.40mm = 3 feet × 304.8 = exactly 3-foot grid. Appears 6× in row at bottom of sheet. Bay width = 6 × 3ft = 18ft (2 units per bay × 3 bays = 3×6m).

model_for_webcad.target_state: FULLY_EXPANDED — all 3 floors built, futura ampliación complete

3 equal floors with regular window grid
6m structural bay width (2 dwelling units side-by-side)
Ground floor large opening + door pattern per unit
Upper floors: 1 window per unit per floor (V1 type 660×1400mm)
